text.p: Following are the main stories in today's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
All newspapers lead with Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad saying banks may charge lower interest rates for trade-linked loans, and higher rates for those not related to trade activities.
-- The opening date of the new Kuala Lumpur international airport at Sepang will be delayedder.
-- Malaysia is expected to record a trade deficit of 1.65 billion ringgit this year, said International Trade & Industry Ministry.
-- The government has given the approval for a fourth private television operator, said Information Minister Mohamed Rahmat.
-- malaysia may seek recourse at the World Trade Organisation against more than a dozen couictive policies against its exporters, said International Trade & Industry Ministry.
